I have updated `rich/_export_format.py` to use a consistent and quoted font family name `"Rich Fira Code"` in the `CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT` template, ensuring it matches the `_SVG_FONT_FAMILY` constant and improves compatibility.

The issue was that the SVG export template in `rich/_export_format.py` used an inconsistent and unquoted font family name (`"Fira Code"` in `@font-face` and `Fira Code` in the `.matrix` class), which could lead to conflicts with local system fonts and rendering issues.

I updated `CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT` to consistently use `"Rich Fira Code"` (matching the `_SVG_FONT_FAMILY` constant) and ensured the font family name is quoted in the CSS. I also updated the font URLs to include `woff2` for better performance and compatibility.

- Updated `CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT` in `rich/_export_format.py`:
    - Changed `font-family: "Fira Code";` to `font-family: "Rich Fira Code";` in both `@font-face` definitions.
    - Added `woff2` sources to `@font-face` definitions.
    - Changed `font-family: Fira Code, monospace;` to `font-family: "Rich Fira Code", monospace;` in the `.{unique_id}-matrix` class.
